items.summaryEn: Total Pixel Space contains every possible digital image, including films of your entire life, every life you never lived, and the lives of every creature or object that ever and never existed on or off the earth, from every possible angle.

items.summaryEn: Separation is a trip through geologic time, depicting the evolution of bizarre hybrids. The film explores the dichotomy between how species diverge and coexist, and our inevitable adaptation to an evolving world.

items.summaryEn: A broken swordsman, a grieving immortal and a cosmic being entwine across timelines to stop an empire built on blood and memory. To save the only family he has left, Hachi must survive his past — and master the demon within.

items.summaryZh: 以 DALL-E 2 图像和后期动画构成的十二分钟科幻短片，是早期完整 AI 叙事电影的重要案例。
items.summaryEn: Running twelve minutes, this science fiction short built from DALL-E 2 images and postproduction animation is an important early example of fully realized AI narrative filmmaking.

items.title: Get Me Out / 囚われて
items.creator: Daniel Antebi
items.summary: Runway AI Film Festival 获奖作品，以生成影像探索叙事、视觉实验与原创表达。
items.summaryZh: Aka 每次试图逃离这座诡异的美国郊区住宅，房子都会阻止他，并迫使他直面过去。
items.summaryEn: Every time Aka tries to escape this bizarre suburban American house, it doesn't let him leave. The house tortures him, making him face his past.

items.title: Fragments Of Nowhere
items.creator: Vallée Duhamel
items.summary: Runway AI Film Festival 获奖作品，以生成影像探索叙事、视觉实验与原创表达。
items.summaryZh: 一部关于现实与感知缝隙的短片。如果现实只是感知的另一层，当这些层次碰撞，会发生什么？时间弯曲，地点漂移，一切都无法久驻。
items.summaryEn: A short film about the spaces between what's real and what's perceived. If reality is just another layer of perception, what happens when those layers collide? Time bends, places shift, and nothing holds still for long.

items.title: Emergence
items.creator: Maddie Hong
items.summary: Runway AI Film Festival 获奖作品，以生成影像探索叙事、视觉实验与原创表达。
items.summaryZh: 在地下蛰伏十七年后，我们破土而出。Emergence 带观众走进一个微小生物生命的最后时刻，以它的视角感受蜕变前的期待、恐惧与喜悦，以及只为一瞬光明而活的意义。
items.summaryEn: After seventeen years underground, we emerge. Emergence invites us into the final moments of one small creature's life. Through its eyes, we experience the anticipation, the fear and the joy of becoming — and what it means to live for one moment of light.

items.title: Editorial
items.creator: Riccardo Fusetti
items.summary: Runway AI Film Festival 获奖作品，以生成影像探索叙事、视觉实验与原创表达。
items.summaryZh: 一部大胆而出人意料的女性主题作品，把趣味与游戏感、超现实与恐怖、真实与虚构并置，交织成一场狂野的发热梦之旅。
items.summaryEn: A bold and unexpected piece about femininity — contrasting the fun and playful with the surreal and horrific, the authentic with the fictitious — blending these elements into a wild, fever-dream rollercoaster.

items.title: e^(i*π) + 1 = 0
items.creator: Junie Lau
items.summary: Runway AI Film Festival 获奖作品，以生成影像探索叙事、视觉实验与原创表达。
items.summaryZh: 一位退休数学家开始创作数字漫画，点燃一个无限宇宙。他的虚拟孩子们跨越时空，试图破解“真相”，并面对深刻的存在命题。
items.summaryEn: A retired mathematician creates digital comics, igniting an infinite universe where his virtual children seek to decode the "truth," grappling with profound existential equations across time and space.

items.title: Afrocidade Oriki

items.summary: Project Odyssey 第二季获奖作品，以叙事、视觉实验或生成影像工艺获得官方评审认可。

items.summaryEn: An award winning work from Project Odyssey Season 2, officially recognized for its storytelling, visual experimentation, or generative filmmaking.

items.title: Instinct
items.creator: Marcello Costa
items.summary: 当原始生存本能撞上现代文明，一个尼安德特人发现所谓进化也可能意味着失去。
items.summaryZh: 当原始生存本能撞上现代文明，一个尼安德特人发现所谓进化也可能意味着失去。
items.summaryEn: When primal survival instinct collides with modern civilization, a Neanderthal discovers that evolution can also mean loss.

items.title: Love at First Sight
items.creator: Jacopo Reale
items.summary: 一个关于凝视、想象与羞涩情感的短片，全部画面由 Kling 2.0 生成。
items.summaryZh: 一个关于凝视、想象与羞涩情感的短片，全部画面由 Kling 2.0 生成。
items.summaryEn: A short about looking, imagination, and shy affection, with every image generated in Kling 2.0.

items.title: Distance Between Two Points Of Me
items.creator: Illya Dutsyk, Bogdan Nesvit, Anatolii Kasianov
items.summary: Runway AI Film Festival 获奖作品，以生成影像探索叙事、视觉实验与原创表达。
items.summaryZh: 影片思考失去家园意味着什么，这也是许多乌克兰人的共同经历。它温柔穿行于在场与缺席、悲伤与感恩之间，展现记忆和希望如何让我们与自我保持联结。
items.summaryEn: The film contemplates what it means to lose a home, as many Ukrainians have. It gently walks through the emotional distance between presence and absence, grief and gratitude, showing how memory and hope help us stay connected to who we are.

items.title: Dear Mom
items.creator: Johans Saldana Guadalupe & Katie Luo
items.summary: Runway AI Film Festival 获奖作品，以生成影像探索叙事、视觉实验与原创表达。
items.summaryZh: Dear Mom 是女儿写给母亲的一封信，想象自己若在二十岁时遇见同龄的母亲。影片以真挚私密的书信，表达创作者对母亲无条件的爱与感激。
items.summaryEn: Dear Mom is a letter from a daughter to her mom imagining if she had met her mom at her own age—20 years old. The film is about unconditional love and gratitude written through a reflective and personal letter from the filmmakers to their moms.

items.title: Animitas
items.creator: Emeric Leprince
items.summary: Runway AI Film Festival 获奖作品，以生成影像探索叙事、视觉实验与原创表达。
items.summaryZh: 一名阿根廷青年在车祸后困于生死之间，他的悲剧故事通过原创素材的转化呈现出来。
items.summaryEn: The tragic tale of a young Argentine trapped in limbo after a car accident comes to life through the transposition of original.

items.title: A Tree Once Grew Here
items.creator: John Semerad & Dara Semerad
items.summary: Runway AI Film Festival 获奖作品，以生成影像探索叙事、视觉实验与原创表达。
items.summaryZh: A Tree Once Grew Here 以引人入胜的视觉、动画与影像讲述一个超越语言的故事，提醒我们必须重建平衡、守护地球，因为已经无法继续拖延。
items.summaryEn: A Tree Once Grew Here combines captivating visuals, animation and imagery, to tell a tale that transcends language. We are reminded that we must rebalance harmony and nurture our planet; because we can no longer afford not to.

items.title: 6000 Lies
items.creator: Simon Rieth
items.summary: Runway AI Film Festival 获奖作品，以生成影像探索叙事、视觉实验与原创表达。
items.summaryZh: 这是一个关于缺失细节，或从未存在之物的故事。人们寻找并试图重现一个孩子的影像，以数千个谎言逼近真相。
items.summaryEn: It is the story of a detail that is missing, or that never existed. The image of a child we are looking for and trying to recreate. Thousands of lies to find the truth.
